subject: Sherwood discovery recap + mutual action plan (draft) & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sherwood discovery recap + mutual action plan (draft) & next steps

Hi Asha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a suggested Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on owners and dates. I captured the pain, success criteria, and next steps below.

Pain & goals (what you told us)
- Inference latency spikes on peak traffic for the current LLM-based summarization pipeline; 99th percentile latency > 1.2s causes user drop-off.
- Unit cost per token is out of line for batch scoring — target is ~30% lower cost at similar result quality.
- Need a reproducible evaluation pipeline and observable KPIs for LLM regressions before wider rollout.

Proposed PoC scope (6-week pilot)
1) Week 0: Kickoff & environment access — network requirements & sample dataset ingest (owner: Sherwood IT) — target 2027-06-07
2) Week 1–3: Inference workload run on a dedicated pilot instance (Redwood Dedicated) — performance/latency tuning and initial cost measurements (owner: Redwood - Marcus Lin)
3) Week 4: Joint quality evaluation vs current model (owner: Sherwood ML lead)
4) Week 5: Final optimization + decision readout (owner: Sherwood stakeholder)
5) Week 6: Handoff plan & success metrics review (owner: Redwood CS - Rachel Kim)

Decision criteria
- 30% reduction in per-token unit cost or clear roadmap to achieve it
- 99th percentile latency improvement to <= 500ms on target request mix
- No unacceptable data residency/security blockers (SOC 2 attestation acceptable)

Immediate next steps (please confirm):
- I will attach a draft Mutual Action Plan (MPA) and a short SOC 2 summary from our security team.
- Can Sherwood confirm: sample traffic dataset, VPC peering or S3 presigned access, and the names/emails of procurement/finance and legal contacts?
- Preferred PO timeframe? (we suggested end of June to align resources)

Attachments: [Attachment: Sherwood_MPA_v0.1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — I’ll update the MPA after your notes and loop in our legal/procurement templates once you confirm the timeframe.

—
Soojin Lee

Subject: Re: Sherwood discovery recap + mutual action plan (draft) & next steps

Thanks Soojin — good summary and aligned on the high level. A few clarifications from our side:

- PoC length: 6 weeks sounds right. We want an explicit Week 4 "quality gate" where our ML team validates outputs on held-out data.
- Procurement timeline: Legal & Procurement are conservative; our target internal approval window is ~June 28–30. If we can get a commercial quote + standard T&Cs by June 20, we can route it.
- Decision maker(s): Mark Holloway (CFO) will sign off on budget; the technical champion is myself and our ML lead, Priya Iyer (cc’d on internal thread later).
- Security: SOC2 summary is helpful — our InfoSec team will want to see KMS details if we do private deployment.

One ask: can Redwood propose success metrics that map to our product telemetry (e.g., % of sessions with latency < 500ms, token cost delta)? If you can include those in the MPA we can attach to our evaluation checklist.

I’ll review the attached MPA and get back with comments by EOD tomorrow.

—
Asha Patel
Director, ML Platforms | Sherwood Analytics

Hi Asha — quick technical notes and dependencies so we can finalize Week 0: 

1) Networking & data access options (pick one):
   - VPC peering to our pilot VPC (preferred for private deployment). Requires CIDR and peering contact.
   - S3 presigned ingestion over TLS (easiest for initial run) — we’ll need a test bucket + sample manifest.

2) Sample traffic: please provide a 24–72 hour compressed sample of production requests and the subset you want to emulate for 95/99 pctl. We’ll use that to construct our batching profile.

3) Resource estimate: for the target throughput you described we recommend a 1× dedicated pod (4x A100 equivalent) for pilot; we can scale after first-week measurements.

I’ve attached a short network_requirements.docx template that lists firewall rules, port expectations, and sample peering steps. Also added placeholder config for ingestion.

Attachments: [Attachment: network_requirements.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Soojin / team — thanks for these details. Quick confirmation from Sherwood: 

- We confirm the 6-week PoC with the Week 4 quality gate.
- Procurement target: internal approval window June 28–30; we will issue a PO by June 30 if commercial and T&Cs are acceptable.
- Decision signatory: Mark Holloway (CFO) — I will loop him into commercial conversations when you have a final quote.

Thanks — Asha
